questions_answered: Which bucket, prefix, and region hold the files? usgs-wma-sentinel-2-aqr-acolite-dsf under version_01, in us-west-2.
Who pays for reads? The provider. The registry shows unsigned access with no AWS account, and no page states requester pays.
What does each scene deliver? Aquatic reflectance COGs for bands 1 to 8, 8A, 11, and 12, an NDWI COG, an ACOLITE settings file, and a processing log.
How are values encoded? Signed 16-bit integers scaled by 10,000, no-data -32,768, negative values retained.
What is the input and processor? Level-1C from ESA through the OData API, corrected with ACOLITE 20221114.0 dark spectrum fitting at 20 m.
Is glint corrected? The optional SWIR residual glint correction was not applied.
How are new scenes announced? An SNS topic named object_created in us-west-2, plus a scene list file on ScienceBase.
How are tile overlaps handled? Both overlapping tiles are processed and delivered, and their values can differ.
questions_open: When does coverage start? ScienceBase gives a start date of 2015-07-25. The metadata says imagery from 2016 and a time period from 2015. The scene list or a bucket probe would settle it.
Does DSF run in tiled or fixed aerosol mode? USGS names only the 300-pixel tile dimension. The per-scene settings file would settle it.
Are non-water pixels written as no-data? USGS names the 0.05 non-water mask threshold but does not say how masked pixels are stored.
Which license governs reuse? The registry names CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO for the Copernicus data. ScienceBase and usgs.gov mark the release CC0 1.0.
How long after sensing does a scene appear? Pages state only daily additions and continual updates.
What does an SNS message carry? No page documents the message format or filter attributes.
Will a newer ACOLITE release create a version_02 prefix, and will earlier scenes be reprocessed? No page says.
Are Sentinel-2C scenes processed, and with which ACOLITE version? Pages name only S2A and S2B. ACOLITE 20221114.0 ships no S2C defaults file.
What is bucket ngwos-rswq-development, which the metadata names as an imagery location? No page explains it.
Which tiles are covered, and how many scenes are skipped for cloud cover above 30 percent? The tile shapefile and scene list were not read.
Do the ACOLITE defaults l2w_mask_negative_rhow=True and l2w_mask_water_parameters=True conflict with the statement that negatives are retained? The settings file and a pixel probe would show.
Does any read cost apply, for example egress outside us-west-2? No page states a price or a condition.
observations: The registry YAML file datasets/usgs_aqr.yaml was added 2025-01-08. Its latest commit, on 2025-07-09, added an ASDI tag.
The FGDC metadata citation links https://registry.opendata.aws/usgs-sentinel-2-aqr-acolite-dsf, which returned HTTP 404. The working entry is https://registry.opendata.aws/usgs_aqr/.
The metadata Globus link uses origin_id 9e967cb6-58c9-4189-b7d2-e28d5b1f0e3e. The ScienceBase web link and the registry use origin_id 8fd8727f-c464-4e86-a5ed-c6db72848c02.
The tutorial's example output reports center band values at site_3, where no NDWI water pixel was found. B01_center is 448.0. This suggests non-water pixels carry values, unverified.
ACOLITE 20221114.0 general defaults set l2w_mask=True, l2w_mask_wave=1600, l2w_mask_threshold=0.0215, l2w_mask_negative_rhow=True, and dsf_residual_glint_correction=False.
ACOLITE 20221114.0 general defaults set dem_pressure=False and dem_source=copernicus30. USGS states it computed pressure from SRTM instead.
ACOLITE 20221114.0 S2A_MSI defaults set dsf_aot_estimate=tiled, dsf_tile_dimensions=600,600, and s2_target_res=10. USGS changed the resolution to 20 m and the tile dimension to 300.
The metadata links the S2A_MSI defaults on the main branch, not the tag. On main the dsf_aot_estimate and dsf_tile_dimensions lines match the tag.
The tutorial scene is S2B_MSIL1C_20230630T183929_N0509_R070_T11TNN_20230630T222241. Its AQR files sit under folder T11TNN.
The ScienceBase summary in the JSON is truncated with [...]. The full text is in the JSON body field and on the item page.
The ScienceBase title, citation, and metadata edition change with each update. Quotes that include an update date will drift.
The usgs.gov data page returned HTTP 403 to a plain request and loaded with browser request headers.
The NDWI entity in the metadata lists a range of -10,000 to -10,000. The band entity lists -10,000 to 10,000.

limitations: No page gives a time from sensing to availability. The registry states daily additions only.

The coverage start is unsettled. ScienceBase gives 2015-07-25, the metadata completeness report says 2016, and the metadata time period begins in 2015. The scene list S2_AQR_Scenes.zip was not read because it is data, not documentation.

The license is unsettled. The registry License field names CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO for the Copernicus data. ScienceBase and usgs.gov mark the release CC0 1.0. data.usgs.gov, read only through a summarizing fetch, links a public domain label. That page is not cited.
Lead not confirmed as stated: no page explicitly says the product has no cloud or shadow layer. The file lists simply name none.
Lead not found: no USGS page names the DSF aerosol estimation mode. Only the 300-pixel tile dimension is documented.
Lead corrected: the registry License sentence ties CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO to the Copernicus Sentinel data, and USGS marks the release CC0 1.0.
No page states whether non-water pixels are no-data or carry values. The tutorial output hints that they carry values.
No USGS publication validating the product was found by web search. The metadata states that no formal attribute accuracy tests were conducted.

The metadata XML is replaced as the dynamic release updates. The cited URL uses the file name parameter, which served the same bytes as the hashed file path on 2026-10-13. A later checker may see a newer edition.
The tutorial is a zip file. Checking its quotes requires downloading and unzipping it. Quotes come from aqr_extraction_tutorial.ipynb cell sources.
Quotes from the registry and ScienceBase HTML pages join text from adjacent page elements with single spaces.
The metadata's registry link returns HTTP 404. The metadata names a second bucket, ngwos-rswq-development, that the registry does not list.
No page states a price. unit_price and monthly_price have no draft claims.
No S3 object was listed, read, or requested. Bucket facts rest on documentation only.
